selection: Fixed old champion .75 + candidate .25, no fusion-weight search; checkpoint selected on fused full val
stop: At >=2000, stop when best fused gain <.001, recent fused gain <.001 and recent standalone gain <.001
test_policy: Closed: no further evaluation of the already completed test split; all new decisions train/val only
matching: Same seed42, starting model, fresh optimizer, LR, crop1024, effective batch8 and planned nodes. If early stops differ, compare matched shared nodes; unequal budgets are disclosed. Resize schedules differ, including augmentation RNG consumption.
space: Actual training needs retained best+last, no duplicated probability export; existing lossless val caches reused
engineering: Strict unchanged-config checkpoint resume only; fault is not a negative result
